ds2.3.2:1.2: Tayo kusalahetū, tayo akusalahetū, tayo avyākatahetū -- nava kāmāvacarahetū, cha rūpāvacarahetū, cha arūpāvacarahetū cha apariyāpannahetū. 1054.
ds2.3.2:3.2: Yo alobho alubbhanā alubbhitattaṃ asārāgo asārajjanā asārajjitattaṃ anabhijjhā alobho kusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:4.2: Yo adoso adussanā adussitattaṃ mettaṃ mettāyanā mettāyitattaṃ anuddā anuddāyanā anuddāyitattaṃ hitesitā anukampā avyāpādo avyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:5.2: Dukkhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ pubbante ñāṇaṃ, aparante ñāṇaṃ pubbantāparante ñāṇaṃ -- idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu ñāṇaṃ -- yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā pariṇāyikā vipassanā sampajaññaṃ patodo paññā paññindriyaṃ paññābalaṃ paññāsatthaṃ paññāpāsādo paññā-āloko paññā-obhāso paññā-pajjoto paññāratanaṃ amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi --
ds2.3.2:8.2: Yo rāgo sārāgo anunayo anurodho nandī nandīrāgo cittassa sārāgo -- icchā mucchā ajjhosānaṃ gedho paligedho saṅgo paṅko ejā māyā janikā sañjananī sibbinī jālinī saritā visattikā suttaṃ visaṭā āyūhanī dutiyā paṇidhi bhavanettī vanaṃ vanatho santhavo sineho apekkhā paṭibandhu āsā āsiṃsanā asiṃsitattaṃ rūpāsā saddāsā gandhāsā rasāsā phoṭṭhabbāsā lābhāsā dhanāsā puttāsā jīvitāsā jappā pajappā abhijappā jappanā jappitattaṃ loluppaṃ loluppāyanā loluppāyitattaṃ puñcikatā sādukamyatā adhammarāgo visamalobho nikanti nikāmanā patthanā pihanā sampatthanā kāmataṇhā bhavataṇha vibhavataṇhā rūpataṇhā arūpataṇhā nirodhataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā ogho yogo gantho upādānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ chandānaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso anusayo pariyuṭṭhānaṃ latā vevicchaṃ dukkhamūlaṃ dukkhanidānaṃ dukkhappabhavo mārapāso mārabalisaṃ māravisayo taṇhā nandītaṇhā jālaṃtaṇhā gaddulaṃtaṇhā samuddo abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:9.2: Anatthaṃ me acarīti āghāto jāyati -- anatthaṃ me caratīti āghāto jāyati -- anatthaṃ me carissatīti āghāto jāyati -- piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . . pe . . . anatthaṃ carati . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:9.3: anatthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:9.5: atthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati -- aṭṭhāne vā pana āghāto jāyati --
ds2.3.2:9.6: yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho kopo pakopo sampakopo doso padoso sampadoso cittassa vyāpatti manopadoso kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ doso dussanā dussitattaṃ vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anattamanatā cittassa --
ds2.3.2:10.2: Dukkhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ pubbante aññāṇaṃ aparante aññāṇaṃ pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ -- yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṅgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ --dummejjhaṃ balyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:12.2: Kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākato kiriyā vyākatesu vā dhammesu alobho adoso amoho --
ds2.3.2:13.2: Tayo kusalahetū tayo akusalahetū tayo avyākatahetū --
ds2.3.2:19.2: adoso? Adussanā adussitattaṃ avyāpādo avyāpajjo adoso kusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:20.2: Dukkhe ñāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . yā evarūpā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo dhammavicayo sallakkhaṇā upalakkhaṇā paccupalakkhaṇā paṇḍiccaṃ kosallaṃ nepuññaṃ vebhavyā cintā upaparikkhā bhūri medhā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ --
ds2.3.2:22.2: Kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākato alobho adoso amoho --
ds2.3.2:23.2: Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalā avyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā -- apariyāpannā
ds2.3.2:23.4: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:24.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sahetukā vedanākkhandho -- . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:25.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā ahetukā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:26.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:27.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:28.1: Katame dhammā hetū ceva sahetukā ca?
ds2.3.2:28.2: Lobho mohena hetu ceva sahetuko ca -- moho lobhena hetu ceva sahetuko ca -- doso mohena hetu ceva sahetuko -- moho dosena hetu ceva sahetuko ca.
ds2.3.2:28.3: Alobho adoso amoho -- te aññamaññaṃ hetū ceva sahetukā ca --
ds2.3.2:29.1: Katame dhammā sahetukā ceva na ca hetū?
ds2.3.2:29.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sahetukā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:29.3: ime dhammā sahetukā ceva na ca hetū. 1079.
ds2.3.2:30.1: Katame dhammā hetū ceva hetusampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:30.2: Lobho mohena hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca -- moho lobhena hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca -- doso mohena hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca -- moho dosena hetu ceva hetusampayutto ca.
ds2.3.2:30.3: Alobho adoso amoho -- te aññamaññaṃ hetū ceva hetusampayuttā ca --
ds2.3.2:30.4: ime dhammā hetū ceva hetusampayuttā ca. 1080.
ds2.3.2:31.1: Katame dhammā hetusampayuttā ceva na ca hetū?
ds2.3.2:31.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:31.3: ime dhammā . . . pe . . . hetū. 1081. Katame dhammā na hetukā sahetukā? Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā na hetu sahetukā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- ime dhammā na hetukā sahetukā. 1082. Katame dhammā na hetū ahetukā? Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā na hetū ahetukā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- sabbañ ca
ds2.3.2:34.3: rūpakkhandho, vedanākkhandho, sañ kkhando, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:36.2: Yeva te dhammā sappaccayā -- teva te dhammā saṅkhatā. 1086.
ds2.3.2:37.2: Yo eva so dhammo appaccayo -- so eva so dhammo asaṅkhato. 1087.
ds2.3.2:39.2: Cakkhāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- yañ ca rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammāyatanapariyāpannaṃ -- asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:41.2: Vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho -- yañ ca rūpaṃ anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammāyatanaṃ pariyāpannaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:42.2: Cattāro ca mahābhūtā catunnañ ca mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ --
ds2.3.2:44.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalā vyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā -- rūpakkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:45.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni va asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:70.2: Yo bhavesu bhavacchando bhavarago bhavanandī -- bhavataṇhā bhāvasineho bhavapariḷāho bhavamucchā bhavajjhosānam
ds2.3.2:71.2: Sassato loko ti vā asassato loko ti vā antavā loko ti vā anatavā loko ti vā, taṃ jīvan taṃ sarīran ti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti vā, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti vā,
ds2.3.2:71.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesaggāho --
ds2.3.2:72.2: Dukkhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhudaye aññenaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ -- pubbante aññāṇaṃ aparante aññāṇaṃ pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ -- idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññānaṃ

ds2.3.2:74.1: Katame dhammā anāsavā? Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu -- ime dhammā anāsavā. 1102. Katame dhammā no āsavā?

ds2.3.2:74.3: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:76.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:78.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:78.3: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:79.1: Katame dhammā āsavā ceva sāsavā ca?
ds2.3.2:79.2: Te ca āsavā āsavā ceva sāsavā ca. 1108.
ds2.3.2:80.1: Katame dhammā sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā?
ds2.3.2:80.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sāsavā te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā
ds2.3.2:80.4: ime dhammā sāsava ceva no ca āsavā. 1109.
ds2.3.2:81.1: Katame dhammā āsavā ceva āsavasampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:81.2: Kāmāsavo avijjāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca -- avijjāsavo kāmāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca -- bhavāsavo avijjāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca avijjāsavo bhāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca diṭṭhāsavo avijjāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca avijjāsavo diṭṭhāsavena āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca --
ds2.3.2:82.1: Katame ceva dhammā āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā?
ds2.3.2:82.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:82.3: ime dhammā āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā. 1111.
ds2.3.2:83.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākātā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā rūpakkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:84.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātū --

ds2.3.2:88.2: Seyyo 'hamasmīti māno -- sadiso 'hamasmīti māno -- hīno 'hamasmīti māno --
ds2.3.2:88.3: ye evarūpo māno maññaṇā maññitattaṃ uṇṇati uṇṇamo dhajo sampaggāho ketukamyatā cittassa --
ds2.3.2:89.2: Sassato loko ti vā asassato loko ti vā antavā loko ti vā anantavā loko ti vā taṃ jīvan taṃ sarīran ti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā -- hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā,
ds2.3.2:89.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:89.5: ṭhapetvā sīlabbataparāmāsasaññojanaṃ sabbā pi micchādiṭṭhi diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ. 1118.
ds2.3.2:90.2: Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati, dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati, saṅghe kaṅkhati vicikicchati, sikkhāya kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, aparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbantāparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati,
ds2.3.2:90.3: yā evarūpā kaṅkhā kaṅkhāyanā kaṅkhāyitattaṃ vimati vicikicchā dveḷhakaṃ dvedhāpatho saṃsayo anekaṃsagāho āsappanā parisappanā apariyogāhanā thambhitattaṃ cittassa manovilekho --
ds2.3.2:91.2: Ito bahiddhā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sīlena suddhivatena suddhisīlalabbatena suddhīti
ds2.3.2:91.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:92.2: Yo bhavesu bhavachando bhavarāgo bhavanandī bhavataṇhā bhavasineho bhavapariḷāho bhavamucchā bhavajjhosānaṃ. --
ds2.3.2:93.2: Yā paralobhasakkāragarukāramānanavandanapūjanāsu issā issāyanā issāyitattaṃ usuyyā usuyyanā usuyitattaṃ --
ds2.3.2:94.4: yaṃ evarūpaṃ maccharaṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭakañcukatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa --
ds2.3.2:95.2: Dukkhe aññāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ, pubbante aññāṇaṃ, aparante aññāṇaṃ pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ, idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ --
ds2.3.2:95.3: yaṃ evarūpaṃ āññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṅgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ balayaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:97.2: Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā
ds2.3.2:97.4: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:98.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacārā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:99.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:100.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:101.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho
ds2.3.2:101.3: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:102.1: Katame dhammā saññojanā ceva saññojaniyā ca?
ds2.3.2:102.2: Tāneva saññojanāni saññojanā ceva saññojaniyā ca. 1130.
ds2.3.2:103.1: Katame dhammā saññojaniyā ceva no ca saññojanā?
ds2.3.2:103.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā saññojaniyā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā sāsava kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā
ds2.3.2:103.4: ime dhammā saññojaniyā ceva no ca saññojanā. 1131.
ds2.3.2:104.1: Katame dhammā saññojanā ceva saññojanasampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:104.2: Kāmarāgasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca -- avijjāsaññojanaṃ kāmarāgasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca; paṭighasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojaneva saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca; avijjāsaññojanaṃ paṭighasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca; mānasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca -- avijjāsaññojanaṃ mānasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca -- diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca. Avijjāsaññojanaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttāñ ca, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, avijjāsaññojanaṃ vicikicchāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, sīlabbataparāmāsasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttāñ ca, avijjāsaññojanaṃ sīlabbataparāmāsasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, avijjāsaññojanaṃ bhavarāgasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, issāsaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, avijjāsaññojanaṃ issāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, macchariyasaññojanaṃ avijjāsaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca, avijjāsaññojanaṃ macchariyasaññojanena saññojanañ ceva saññojanasampayuttañ ca --
ds2.3.2:104.3: ime dhammā saññojanā ceva saññojanasampayuttā ca. 1132.
ds2.3.2:105.1: Katame dhammā saññojanasampayuttā ceva no ca saññojanā?
ds2.3.2:105.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:105.3: ime dhammā saññojanasampayuttā ceva no ca saññojanā. 1133.
ds2.3.2:106.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā sāsavā kusalākusalā vyākatā dhammā kāmāvacārā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:107.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:108.3: abijjhākāyagantho vyāpādo kāyagantho sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho idaṃ saccābhiniveso kāyagantho. 1136.
ds2.3.2:109.2: Yo rāgo sārāgo anunayo anurodho nandī nandīrāgo cittassa sārāgo -- icchā mucchā ajjhosānaṃ gedho paligedho saṅgo paṅko ejā māyā janikā sañjananī sibbinī jālinī saritā visattikā suttaṃ visaṭā āyūhanī dutiyā paṇidhi bhavanetti vanaṃ vanatho santhavo sineho apekkhā paṭibandhu āsā āsiṃsanā āsiṃsitattaṃ rūpāsā saddāsā gandhāsā rasāsā phoṭṭhabbāsā lābhāsā dhanāsā puttāsā jīvitāsā jappā pajappā abhijappā jappanā jappitattaṃ loluppaṃ loluppāyanā loluppāyitattaṃ puñcikatā sādukamyatā adhammarāgo visamalobho nikanti nikāmanā patthanā pihanā sampatthanā kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā rūpataṇhā arūpataṇhā nirodhataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabbataṇhā dhammataṇhā ogho yogo gantho upādānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ chandanaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso anusayo pariyuṭṭhānaṃ lātā vevicchaṃ dukkhamūlaṃ dukkhanidānaṃ dukkhappabhavo mārapāso mārabaḷisaṃ māravisayo taṇhā nandītaṇhā jālaṃtaṇhā gaddulaṃtaṇhā samuddo abhijjhālobho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:110.2: Anatthaṃ me acarīti āghāto jāyati -- anatthaṃ me caratīti āghāto jāyati, anatthaṃ me carissatīti āghāto jāyati, piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . . pe . . . anatthaṃ carati . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:110.3: anatthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati, appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:110.5: atthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati, aṭṭhāne vā pana āghāto jāyati
ds2.3.2:110.6: yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho kopo pakopo sampakopo doso padoso sampadoso cittassa vyāpatti manopadoso kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ doso dussanā dussitattaṃ vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anattamanatā cittassa --
ds2.3.2:111.2: Ito bahiddhā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sīlena suddhivatena suddhisīlabbatena suddhīti
ds2.3.2:111.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:112.2: Sassato loko idam eva saccaṃ moghaṃ aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.3: asassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.4: antavā loko, idam eva saccam mogham aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.5: anantavā loko, idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.6: jīvan taṃ sarīraṃ idaṃ eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.7: aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā;
ds2.3.2:112.8: hoti tathāgato param maraṇā idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā,
ds2.3.2:112.9: na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā,
ds2.3.2:112.10: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā,
ds2.3.2:112.11: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti vā,
ds2.3.2:112.12: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipāriyesagāho,
ds2.3.2:112.14: ṭhapetvā sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kāyaganthaṃ sabbā pi micchādiṭṭhi, idaṃ saccābhiniveso kāyagantho --
ds2.3.2:114.2: Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalā-āvyakatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā
ds2.3.2:114.4: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:115.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:116.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:117.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:118.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippāyuttā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:119.1: Katame dhammā ganthā ceva ganthaniyā ca?
ds2.3.2:119.2: Teva ganthā ganthā ceva ganthaniyā ca. 1146.
ds2.3.2:120.1: Katame dhammā ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā?
ds2.3.2:120.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā ganthaniyā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:120.4: ime dhammā ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā. 1147.
ds2.3.2:121.1: Katame dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:121.2: Sīlabbataparāmāso kāyagantho, abhijjhākāyaganthena gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca -- abhijjhākāyagantho sīlabbataparāmāsakāyaganthena gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca idaṃ saccābhiniveso kāyagantho abhijjhākāyaganthena gantho ceva ganthasampayutto ca, abhijjhākāyagandho idaṃ saccābhinivesakāyaganthena gandho ceva ganthasampayutto ca --
ds2.3.2:121.3: ime dhammā ganthā ceva ganthasampayuttā ca. 1148.
ds2.3.2:122.1: Katame dhammā ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā?
ds2.3.2:122.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandhaṃ --
ds2.3.2:122.3: ime dhammā . . . pe . . . no ca ganthā. 1149.
ds2.3.2:123.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā sāsavā kusalākusalā vyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā,
ds2.3.2:124.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:127.3: kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ, vyāpādanīvaraṇaṃ, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ, uddhacca-nīvaranaṃ, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ. 1153.
ds2.3.2:128.2: Yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmataṇhā kāmasineho kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ --
ds2.3.2:129.2: Anatthaṃ me acarīti āghāto jāyati, anatthaṃ me caratīti āghāto jāyati,
ds2.3.2:129.4: piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . . pe . . . anatthaṃ carati . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:129.5: anatthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati, appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:129.7: atthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati aṭṭhāne vā pana āghāto jāyati,
ds2.3.2:129.8: yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto paṭighaṃ virodho kopo pakopo sampakopo doso padoso sampadoso cittassa vyāpatti manopadoso kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ doso dussanā dussitattaṃ vyāpatti vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ viroḍho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anaṭṭamanatā cittassa,
ds2.3.2:131.2: Yā cittassa akalyatā akammaññatā oḷīyanā sallīyanā līnaṃ līyanā līyitattaṃ thīnaṃ thīyanā thīyitattaṃ cittassa --
ds2.3.2:132.2: Yā kāyassa akalyatā akammaññatā onāho pariyonāho anto samorodho middhaṃ soppaṃ pacalāyikā soppaṃ supinā supitattaṃ,
ds2.3.2:132.4: Iti idañ ca thīnaṃ idañ ca middhaṃ
ds2.3.2:134.2: Yaṃ cittassa uddhaccaṃ avūpasamo cetaso vikkhepo bhantattaṃ cittassa --
ds2.3.2:135.2: Akappiye kappiyasaññita, kappiye akappiyasaññitā, avajje vajjasaññitā, vajje avajjasaññitā,
ds2.3.2:135.3: yaṃ evarūpaṃ kukkuccaṃ kukkuccāyanā kukkuccāyitattaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho,
ds2.3.2:135.5: Iti, idañ ca uddhaccaṃ idañ ca kukkuccaṃ --
ds2.3.2:136.2: Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati, saṅghe kaṅkhati vicikicchati, sikkhāya kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, aparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbantāparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati,

ds2.3.2:139.2: Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā --

ds2.3.2:140.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:141.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:144.1: Katame dhammā nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca?
ds2.3.2:144.2: Tāneva nīvaraṇāni nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā ca. 1169.

ds2.3.2:146.2: Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, vyāpādanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaranaṃ vyāpādanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca thīnamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttāñ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ thīnamiddhanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttāñ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇeva nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca kukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ kukkuccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, vyāpādānīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ vyāpādanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ thīnamiddhanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, kukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ uddaccanīvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddaccanīvaraṇaṃ kukkuccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇena nīvaranañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ vicikicchānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, avijjānīvaraṇaṃ uddhaccanīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccanīvaraṇaṃ avijjānīvaraṇena nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca --

ds2.3.2:149.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:155.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:156.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:157.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā -- vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --

ds2.3.2:161.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:169.2: Sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:173.2: Cittañ ca avasesañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:175.2: Cittañ ca avasesañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:177.2: Cittañ ca avasesañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:181.2: Cittañ ca sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:183.2: Cittañ ca sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:188.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā
ds2.3.2:189.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā
ds2.3.2:189.4: ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā, yañ ca rūpaṃ na kammassa katattā, apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:191.2: Yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmataṇhā kāmasineho kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ --
ds2.3.2:192.2: Natthi diṇṇaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paraloko natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā, ye imañ ca lokaṃ parañ ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchīkatvā pavedentīti --
ds2.3.2:192.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:192.5: ṭhapetvā sīlabbatupādānaṃ ca attavādupādānañ ca, sabbāpi micchādiṭṭhi diṭṭhupādānaṃ. 1216.
ds2.3.2:193.2: Ito bahiddhā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sīlena suddhivatena suddhisīlabbatena suddhītiyā
ds2.3.2:193.3: evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:194.2: Idha assutavā puthujjano, ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
ds2.3.2:194.6: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññaṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ,

ds2.3.2:196.4: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:197.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā,
ds2.3.2:198.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:199.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā vedakākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:200.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippāyuttā, vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho,
ds2.3.2:200.3: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:201.1: Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca?
ds2.3.2:201.2: Tāneva upādānāni upādānā ceva upādāniyā ca. 1224.
ds2.3.2:202.1: Katame dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā?
ds2.3.2:202.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā upādāniyā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā
ds2.3.2:202.4: ime dhammā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā. 1225.
ds2.3.2:203.1: Katame dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:203.2: Diṭṭhupādānaṃ kāmupādānena upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca -- kāmupādānaṃ diṭṭhupādānena upādānāñ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca -- sīlabbatupādānaṃ kāmupādānena upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca -- kāmupādānaṃ sīlabbatupādānena upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca -- attavādupādānaṃ kāmupādānena upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca kāmupādānaṃ attavādupādānena upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca --
ds2.3.2:203.3: ime dhammā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā ca. 1226.
ds2.3.2:204.1: Katame dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā?
ds2.3.2:204.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā -- te dhamme ṭhapetvā vedanākkhandho . . . pe . . . viññāṇakkhandho --
ds2.3.2:204.3: ime dhammā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā. 1227.
ds2.3.2:205.2: Tehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā --
ds2.3.2:206.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:207.3: Lobho doso moho māno, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, thīnaṃ, uddhaccaṃ, ahirikaṃ, anottappam. 1230.
ds2.3.2:208.2: Yo rāgo sārāgo anunayo anurodho nandī nandīrāgo cittassa sārāgo -- icchā mucchā ajjhosānaṃ gedho paligedho saṅgo paṅko ejā māyā janikā sañjananī sibbinī jālinī saritā visattikā suttaṃ visaṭā āyūhanī dutiyā paṇidhi bhavanetti vanaṃ vanatho santhavo sineho apekkhā paṭibandhu āsā āsiṃsanā āsiṃsitattaṃ rūpāsā saddāsa gandhāsā rasāsā phoṭṭhabbāsā lābhāsā dhanāsā puttāsā jīvitāsā jappā pajappā abhijappā jappanā jappitattaṃ loluppaṃ loluppāyanā loluppāyitattaṃ -- puñcikatā sādukamyatā adhammarāgo visamalobho nikantī nikāmanā patthanā sampatthanā kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vihavataṇhā rūpataṇhā, arūpataṇhā nirodhataṇhā saddataṇhā gandhataṇhā rasataṇhā phoṭṭhabba taṇhā dhammataṇhā ogho yogo gantho upādānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ chandanaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso anusayo pariyuṭṭhānaṃ latā vevicchaṃ dukkhamūlaṃ dukkhanidānaṃ dukkhappabhavo mārapāso mārabaḷisaṃ māravisayo taṇhā nandītaṇhā jālaṃtaṇhā gaddulaṃtaṇhā samuddo abhijjhālobho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:209.2: Anatthaṃ me acarīti āghāto jāyati, anatthaṃ me caratīti āghāto jāyati, anatthaṃ me carissatīti āghāto jāyati, piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acari . . . pe . . . anatthaṃ carati . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:209.3: anatthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati, appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acari . . . pe . . .
ds2.3.2:209.5: atthaṃ carissatīti āghāto jāyati, aṭṭhāne vā pana āghāto jāyati,
ds2.3.2:209.6: yo evarūpo cittassa āghāto paṭighāto paṭighaṃ paṭivirodho kopo pakopo sampakopo doso padoso sampadoso citassa vyāpatti manopadoso kodho kujjhanā kujjhitattaṃ doso dussanā dussitattaṃ vyāpaṭṭi vyāpajjanā vyāpajjitattaṃ virodho paṭivirodho caṇḍikkaṃ asuropo anukkamanatā cittassa --
ds2.3.2:210.2: Dukkhe aññāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . pubbante aññāṇaṃ aparante aññāṇaṃ pubbantāparante aññāṇaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu aññāṇaṃ --
ds2.3.2:210.3: yaṃ evarāpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṅgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā apaccavekkhanā apaccakkhakammaṃ dummejjhaṃ balyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijjogho avijjāyogo avijjānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ --
ds2.3.2:211.2: Seyyo 'hamasmīti māno sadiso 'hamasmīti māno, hīno 'hamasmīti māno,
ds2.3.2:211.3: yo evarūpo māno maññanā maññitattaṃ unnati unnamo dhajo sampaggāho ketukamyatā cittassa --
ds2.3.2:212.2: Sassato loko ti vā asassato loko ti vā antavā loko ti vā anantavā loko ti vā taṃ jīvan taṃ sarīran ti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti vā, hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā, neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā,
ds2.3.2:212.3: yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahaṇaṃ diṭṭhikantāro diṭṭhivisūkāyikaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ gāho paṭiggāho abhiniveso parāmāso kummaggo micchāpatho micchattaṃ titthāyatanaṃ vipariyesagāho --
ds2.3.2:213.2: Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati, dhamme kaṅkhati vicikicchati, saṅghe kaṅkhati vicikicchati sikkhāya kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, aparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, pubbantāparante kaṅkhati vicikicchati, idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppannesu dhammesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati,

ds2.3.2:214.2: Yā cittassa akalayatā akammaññatā olīyanā sallīyanā līnaṃ līyanā līyitattaṃ thīnaṃ thīyanā thīyitattaṃ cittassa --
ds2.3.2:215.2: Yaṃ cittassa uddhaccaṃ vūpasamo cetaso vikkhepo bhantattaṃ cittassa --
ds2.3.2:216.2: Yaṃ na hiriyati hiriyitabbena -- na hiriyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.2:217.2: Yaṃ na ottappati ottappitabbena -- na ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā --
ds2.3.2:219.2: Te dhamme ṭhapetvā avasesā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā --
ds2.3.2:219.4: sabbañ ca rūpaṃ asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --
ds2.3.2:220.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalāvyākatā dhammā kāmāvacarā rūpāvacarā arūpāvacarā apariyāpannā,
ds2.3.2:221.2: Apariyāpannā maggā ca maggaphalāni ca -- asaṅkhatā ca dhātu --

ds2.3.2:230.1: Katame dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca?
ds2.3.2:230.2: Lobho mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, moho lobhena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, doso mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, moho dosena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, māno mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, moho mānena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, diṭṭhi mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, moho diṭṭhiyā kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, vicikicchā mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, moho vicikicchāya kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, thīnaṃ mohena kileso ceva kilesesampatuttañ ca, moho thīnena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, uddhaccaṃ mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca. ds2.3.2:231.1: Lobho uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, uddhaccaṃ lobhena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, doso uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, uddhaccaṃ dosena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, moho uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, uddhaccaṃ mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, māno uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, uddhaccaṃ mānena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, diṭṭhi uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, uddhaccaṃ diṭṭhiyā kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, vicikicchā uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, uddhaccaṃ vicikicchāya kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, thīnaṃ uddhacena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, uddhacchaṃ thīnena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, ahirikaṃ uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccaṃ ahirikena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, anottappaṃ uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccaṃ anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, lobho ahirikena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca. ds2.3.2:232.1: lobho anattappena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, anottappaṃ lobhena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, doso anothappena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, anottappaṃ dosena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, moho anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, anottappaṃ mohena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, māno anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca, anottappaṃ. mānena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, diṭṭhi anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, anottappaṃ diṭṭhiyā kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, vicikicchā anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttā ca, anottappaṃ vicikicchāya kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, thīnaṃ anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, anottappaṃ thīnena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, uddhaccaṃ anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, anottappaṃ uddhaccena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, ahirikaṃ anottappena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca, anottappaṃ ahirikena kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca.
ds2.3.2:232.2: Ime dhammā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā ca. 1251.
